title: macaranga carrii var. womersleyi
intro: Macaranga carrii var. womersleyi, commonly known as the Queensland wild lime, is a species of flowering plant in the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Australian Aboriginal medicine, where it is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to aid in wound healing and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Macaranga carrii var. womersleyi are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other phytochemicals that have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the efficacy of this plant in modern medicine.
